To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
barriers to entry are not the same for large and small entrants.

the barriers to entry in Spanish manufacturing industries are not independent of start-up size and that the variables that affect the barriers to entry are different depending on the size range of the start-up.
the determinants of entry are not independent of start-up size and that the size range at the beginning of their activities is an important variable to explain the size of the firms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between barriers to entry, start-up size and growth of the entrants.
the relationship between barriers to entry in Spanish manufacturing industries and the size at which new firms decide to enter the market.
the determinants of the start-up size of firms in Spanish manufacturing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the barriers to entry are not independent of the size of the entrant.
the determinants of entry are not independent of the size of the entrant.
the size distribution of entrants is not independent of the barriers to entry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the size at which firms enter is not independent of the barriers to entry.
the determinants of entry are not independent of the start-up size of the entrant.
the determinants of entry are not independent of the start-up size.

the determinants of start-up size of the entrant firms are not independent of the barriers to entry.
